name: VolumetricFire Slice Contouring
definition: A slice-based contouring algorithm that extracts isosurfaces from volumetric data by processing slices sequentially. It maintains an active edge list, handles topology changes via split and merge operations, and generates triangle fans for each slice to represent the contour.
summary: VolumetricFire Slice Contouring is a slice-based algorithm that extracts isosurfaces by maintaining an active edge list and handling topology changes via split and merge operations to generate triangle fans.
